Stephen Robinson: Aberdeen sack head coach with club 11th in Scottish Premiership after Hibs defeat
Aberdeen have parted ways with Robinson after their 4-0 defeat to Hibernian; the Dons have won three of their 12 Premiership games this season; the 51-year-old left St Mirren to take charge at Pittodrie in March
Monday 9 November 2026 16:46, UK
Aberdeen have sacked Stephen Robinson with the club sitting 11th in the Scottish Premiership.
It follows their 4-0 loss to Hibernian on Saturday, which was their fourth league defeat in five games.
The Dons have lost seven of their 12 Premiership matches this season and lost 1-0 to Rangers in the semi-finals of the Scottish League Cup.
Fans inside Pittodrie called for his sacking during their defeat to Hibs, with the 51-year-old admitting the performance was not good enough, but he would carry on as manager until told otherwise.
Robinson joined from Scottish Premiership rivals St Mirren in March, signing a deal until the summer of 2029.
He saved the Dons from the relegation play-offs last season, after leading the Buddies to three consecutive top-six finishes, plus the League Cup trophy in December.
Aberdeen have the international break before their next league fixture away to Kilmarnock on November 21 to bring in a replacement.
Boyd: Aberdeen 'miles off it'
Sky Sports' Kris Boyd:
"It's not worked out the way that he [Robinson] would have thought it would have.
"Coming in last year and keeping Aberdeen in the league has got to be considered a success, but obviously they lost out in the semi-final last week and it's not been the start of the season that Aberdeen would have expected.
"I've got to be honest, I think there's a lot of other factors for me why the Stephen Robertson regime at Aberdeen hasn't worked.
"There are other people in there who have got to be held accountable as well.
"It's not been great for Aberdeen. They will tell you they're the third biggest team in the country, but right now, they're miles off it and they're going to have to start getting results."

מועדון אברדין מהפרמיירליג הסקוטית הודיע על פרידה מהמאמן סטיבן רובינסון, לאחר שהקבוצה הידרדרה למקום ה-11 בטבלה. ההחלטה הגיעה בעקבות תבוסה 4-0 להיברניאן, שהייתה הפסד הליגה הרביעי של הקבוצה בחמישה משחקים.

רובינסון בן ה-51 הגיע לתפקיד בחודש מרץ מיריבתה הליגה סט מירן, והצליח להציל בעונה שעברה את אברדין ממשחקי המבחן נגד הירידה. כעת, למועדון יש זמן עד למשחק הבא מול קילמרנוק ב-21 בנובמבר כדי למצוא מאמן מחליף.
